active.name: Mover
active.note: Each round it copies the step and gives it to the bird on the perch: [move | across | 1/60]. That is the whole of “start moving right”. It does not know what it is moving, only that the bird on the perch goes somewhere.

thing.text:
MOVING

The Mover is handed [a step].

Each round it copies the step
and gives it to the bird on
the PERCH, the pedestal
beside its desk:

  [move | across | 1/60]

That is the whole of "start
moving right".

TO RUN IT

Press SPACE on the star: it
slides right and stops at
the table's edge. "." stops.

THE ROBOT IS ON ITS BACK.
Hold the star and press
Ctrl+P (or the gear on the
holding card) to go through
its door and watch the
robot at work. Escape
comes back out.

In there, pick up the step,
type a minus, and it goes
the other way.

WHAT IS NOT HERE

The robot does not know what
it is moving. It knows the
bird on the perch goes
somewhere.

Out here she is a bird to the
star. On a thing's panel the
perch holds a bird to THAT
thing -- so the same two
steps move anything: put the
robot on a panel and it moves
whatever the panel belongs to.
THAT is what a behaviour is.
